description: Regression values of this repository for DMD (rank 20) of 100 snapshots (t = 150 to 200, one per 0.5 time units) of the Re=100 limit cycle. dmd_spectrum.dat lists five conjugate pairs ordered by |mu|. Row 3 is the shedding frequency St = 0.166 (literature value for the 2D cylinder at Re = 100: about 0.165). Rows 5, 7 and 1 are its second, fourth and third multiples (0.3316, 0.6630, 0.4974).
